name: Change
description: A planned or completed modification to a system, process, or infrastructure component.

name: Incident
description: An unexpected disruption or quality degradation of a service.

name: Meeting
description: Minutes or agenda for a team meeting, review, or discussion.

name: Note
description: A free-form note, observation, or brief record.

name: Post
description: A blog-style post, announcement, or article.

name: Procedure
description: A step-by-step operational procedure or runbook.

name: Report
description: A formal or informal report summarising findings, metrics, or status.

name: Task
description: A work item or action to be tracked and completed.
